# PUT /api/v1/user/actions/variables/{variablename}

Updates a user-level variable created by current doer

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-133`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| variablename | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UpdateVariableOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | False | must match ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ if provided |
| `value` | string | True | max 65536 runes |
| `description` | string | False | max 4096 runes, truncated if longer |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid variable name or data too long
- **404** — Variable not found
- **500** — Internal error

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Secret/variable names must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive) | validation | Name does not match namePattern regex |
| Secret/variable names cannot start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix | validation | Name matches forbiddenPrefixPattern |
| Secret/variable name 'CI' is reserved and cannot be used | validation | strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Variable data cannot exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable names are uppercased before storage | business_logic | Always on insert/update |
